# Thermotraffic opens automated cold store in Wrexham

By Caroline Peachey 6th October 2026 2 Mins Read

Temperature-controlled logistics provider Thermotraffic has expanded its distribution centre in Wrexham with a new automated cold store.

The expansion, completed on 28 September 2026 and operational from October, adds around 19,300 pallet spaces.

It takes total capacity at the site to around 33,150 pallet spaces, equivalent to 77,000 tonnes.

The development is Thermotraffic’s first automated warehouse in the UK. The company said the automated systems have been introduced to improve operational efficiency and workplace safety.

The expansion includes a new production area, bringing storage, handling and services, including labelling, repacking, X-ray and metal detection, blast freezing, up-tempering and microwaving, together at the Wrexham facility.

Thermotraffic said combining additional storage capacity with handling and production services at the same location is intended to help customers reduce unnecessary movements in supply chains and respond more effectively to seasonal peaks and changing volumes

# NewCold expands Truganina cold-storage hub

 By Jan Arreza | 17 September 2026 

## Global cold-chain logistics company, NewCold, has officially opened its $200 million freezer expansion, adding 80,000 pallet positions to Australia’s largest automated cold-storage operations – taking the facility to 180,000 pallet positions.

Founder and CEO, Bram Hage, travelled from the Netherlands for the opening, marking the company’s latest investment in Australia since entering the market in 2017.

NewCold’s two cold-storage facilities at Truganina now have a combined capacity of 405,000 pallet positions across frozen, chilled and ambient storage.

Standing 40 metres high and operating at minus 23 degrees Celsius, the 10,453 square metre freezer is one of the world’s largest automated high-bay cold-storage facilities and stores food for major manufacturers including McCain, Peters and Patties.

The expansion comes as changing work and eating habits drive demand for convenient food, with CSIRO forecasting Australian consumption of prepared and frozen packaged meals to grow to $3.7 billion by 2030.

The opening of NewCold's expanded Truganina facility.

The company has opened its new expanded facility in Truganina, supporting more than 200 local jobs.

The facility is one of the most advanced automated high-bay cold storage operations anywhere in the world.

It has grown by an extra 80,000 pallet positions, bringing its total capacity to 405,000 pallets.

This will boost Victoria’s:

- supply chain resilience
- logistics capability
- advanced automated warehousing credentials.

NewCold is a Netherlands-headquartered global cold-chain logistics company specialising in automated, temperature-controlled warehousing and distribution.

In Victoria, the Truganina campus supports customers requiring frozen, chilled and ambient storage and distribution.

September 25, 2026

Movianto has opened a major pharmaceutical cold store in Germany. The Wiesloch hub adds chilled, frozen, and future ultra low temperature capacity to Yusen Logistics’ European healthcare network. 

#### IN Brief:

- The Wiesloch facility provides approximately 30,000 sq m of pharmaceutical warehousing and is due to become fully operational in November.
- Capacity includes 32,000 ambient positions, 10,000 chilled positions, dedicated deep freeze storage, and planned ultra low temperature capability.
- The site connects directly with Eurotranspharma's specialist healthcare delivery network across nine European countries.

Movianto has opened a 30,000 sq m pharmaceutical logistics hub in Wiesloch, Germany, adding substantial temperature controlled storage capacity to the European healthcare network operated by parent company Yusen Logistics.
